subject: english
stem: Which sentence correctly uses no article with a day name?
options: The club meets on an Monday.
The club meets on the Monday every week.
The club meets on a Monday the.

optionRationales.reason: The club meets on an Monday.：專名與發音皆不合。
The club meets on Monday.：Monday 是日名專有詞，前面不加冠詞。
The club meets on the Monday every week.：一般週期日名不需 the。
The club meets on a Monday the.：限定詞位置錯誤。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數或不可數名詞表一般類別、專有名詞與固定制度性用法時辨識零冠詞，並與特定 the 用法對比。」可推出 The club meets on Monday.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The club meets on Monday. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
